purpose: Throughput trial for maxAlphaCo=0.30 with six alpha subcycles after the 9 s checkpoint; not an event-classification result
reason: Raising maxAlphaCo allowed the step to grow only until the global Courant limit of 0.40. The resulting ~1.29x deltaT gain was smaller than the 1.5x MULES work from six subcycles, so net throughput fell.
notes: The earlier maxAlphaCo=0.20 / four-subcycle controls remain the production setting.
Per-subcycle interface Courant would have remained 0.05; the trial was stopped for throughput, not accuracy.
